data.summary:
Payments Business Analyst with 7+ years of experience, including 5 years in payments, banking, and financial services. Skilled in gathering and analyzing
business requirements, managing stakeholders, creating user stories, supporting UAT, and delivering solutions in Agile environments. large-scale transformation initiatives. Proven ability to bridge business and technology teams to deliver efficient and compliant payment solutions.
